text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a short night window for a feature-flag toggle (routing.hotfix). Target: Sun 2026-04-05 23:00-00:30 UTC. Need quick sign-off on ramp + rollback rules.
aj: Proposed ramp: 0.5% (5m) -> 3% (10m) -> 15% (20m). Hold at each stage.

sam: Metrics to watch: errors (5xx + infer-fail) and p95 latency. Thresholds: errors > 0.7% OR p95 > 350ms => hold.
maria: Add quality check: sample 0.5% outputs via quick-eval script; if quality regression > 4% hold.
oncall-ops: I'll be oncall. Set alerts to require 2 consecutive 3m buckets to avoid flapping.

maria: Deploy-bot, schedule and annotate release notes with auto-pin behavior.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2026-04-05T23:00Z -> 2026-04-06T00:30Z. Rollout steps queued. Auto-pin on breach configured.

aj: Safety: if hold at stage >=3%, auto-pin that cohort and open incident channel. Also enable variant fallback to quant-v1 during triage.
sam: If pinned, we should also record which cohort IDs were affected (cohort_tag). Add `rollout_id=hotfix-20260405` telemetry tag.

maria: Runbook snippet: 
```
deploybot schedule --service inference-api \
  --window "2026-04-05T23:00Z/2026-04-06T00:30Z" \
  --ff routing.hotfix --ramp "0.5:5m,3:10m,15:20m" \
  --holds "errors>0.7% OR p95>350ms OR quality_regress>4%" \
  --hold-aggregation "2x3m" --on-breach pin=previous --fallback quant-v1 \
  --meta rollout_id=hotfix-20260405
```

oncall-ops: I will attach alert screenshots before EOD Friday. If auto-pin fails, I will manually run the rollback play and post updates here.

maria: Approvals?
aj: +1
sam: +1
oncall-ops: +1

deploy-bot: Rollout APPROVED and notifications scheduled to post in #eng-releases at T-30m and start.
